title: A project's extension of the schema of the SpecSheriff guidelines
$comment: What a project's own guidelines add to the structure of the specification, kept in specs/_schema/project.schema.json and composed with the schema by the tools. It may only add: kinds of node of its own, fields of a kind the SpecSheriff guidelines have, and properties of a file and of a link. Each addition is a condition beside those the schema sets, so nothing it holds loosens a condition of the schema, and a name the schema already defines is refused, so nothing redefines one.

kinds.$comment: The project's own kinds of node, each by its name: whether its nodes need code, and the JSON Schema of the fields its nodes hold beside those every node holds. A kind of the SpecSheriff guidelines cannot be declared again, nor a name an earlier release gave one of them, which the reindex renames: record, recordType, rule and domain.

needsCode.$comment: false where the nodes of the kind are carried out by tools or people rather than code, which exempts them from being implemented.

fields.$comment: The fields added to a kind of the SpecSheriff guidelines, as a JSON Schema of their properties, by the kind's name. The nodes of the SpecSheriff guidelines need not hold them.

file.$comment: The properties added to a file of the specification, as a JSON Schema of them.

link.$comment: The properties added to a link, as a JSON Schema of them.
